description: June 20 birthday meaning: Gemini or Cancer cusp, birthday number 2, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, June 20 is a cusp birthday: depending on the year, time and place of birth, the Sun is in Gemini or Cancer. In numerology the day gives birthday number 2, while the Life Path also depends on the birth year. Many people born on cusp dates recognise something of both signs.

sections.heading: The June 20 birthday in astrology
paragraphs: Sign depends on birth year and time on June 20th: the Sun is usually in late Gemini but stands close to Cancer. The cusp is often described as a meeting of head and heart, Mercury's quickness touched by the Moon's sensitivity. Birthday number 2 deepens the relational emphasis, suggesting someone who talks easily and listens even better.

Astronomically, June 20 puts the Sun near 28° Gemini in most years, inside the third ten-degree slice of the sign, which tradition links with Uranus. Birthdays around June 20 to June 22 fall on the Gemini–Cancer cusp, which also lines up with the June solstice. Gemini's curiosity and talk meet Cancer's feeling and attachment to home. Whether the Sun had already entered Cancer at your birth depends on the year, the hour and the place, since the boundary shifts by up to a day across years; a natal chart answers that precisely. People who identify with both signs are often described as emotionally articulate, able to name what they feel and to listen closely, with a busy mind and a heart that stays near family.

sections.heading: Birthday number and Life Path for June 20
paragraphs: A birthday on the 20th reduces as 2 + 0 = 2, giving a birthday number of 2. The 0 is often read as amplifying the 2, intensifying its sensitivity, diplomacy and emotional awareness. Those born on the 20th are frequently described as intuitive companions and natural team members, attuned to atmosphere and moods. They may pick up the feeling in a room before anyone has spoken. As a secondary number in the chart, the 20 tends to show in close relationships and group work. Protecting their own energy, and saying no kindly, is a recurring theme for this birthday.

Add the birth year and the picture shifts again: a June 20 birthday gives Life Path 9 for 1990, 1 for 2000, 11 for 2010 and 3 for 2020. Some birth years on this date reach the master number 11. Read the birthday number as a secondary note beside that main theme.

sections.heading: Season, Chinese zodiac and famous June 20 birthdays
paragraphs: A June birthday falls at the height of northern summer, around the longest days of the year, while in the southern hemisphere it marks the darkest stretch near the winter solstice. Gemini covers most of the month, with Cancer beginning around June 21. June is month 6 in numerology, a number of care, responsibility and home, which foreshadows the Cancerian turn at the month's end. June 20 is the 171st day of the year (172nd in a leap year). Counting forward, the next sign change, into Cancer, is usually complete within 2 days, by June 22.

By June 20 the Chinese new year is well under way, which means the animal and element are those of the calendar birth year. Among the best-known people with a June 20 birthday are Nicole Kidman (1967), Frank Lampard (1978) and John Goodman (1952).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is June 20?
faq.answer: June 20 is a cusp date. Between 1930 and 2030 the Sun is in Gemini or Cancer on this date depending on the year, the time of birth and the time zone, and in most years at noon UTC it is in Gemini. The zodiac sign calculator settles it for a specific birth date.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on June 20?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On June 20 the Life Path is 6 in 1960, 7 in 1970, 8 in 1980, 9 in 1990, 1 in 2000, 11 in 2010 and 3 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 2 for everyone born on the 20th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on June 20?
faq.answer: For the Chinese zodiac, Lunar New Year has always passed by June 20, so the animal is simply the one for the birth year.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on June 20?
faq.answer: Well-known people born on June 20 include Nicole Kidman (1967), Frank Lampard (1978) and John Goodman (1952). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
